headline.purpose: Desktop page titles; 36px at up to 900px before the mobile role applies.

title.purpose: Ruled form and detail sections; 18px at up to 600px.

body.purpose: General operational copy, in a local sans-serif stack.

description.purpose: Muted page summaries, at most 72ch; 13px at up to 600px.

table-heading.purpose: Uppercase column labels; not data cells or row headings.

shadows.name: dialog-shadow
shadows.purpose: Only floating dialogs and the navigation drawer; resting panels remain flat.

motion.name: dialog-enter
motion.purpose: Dialog opacity .5 to 1; translate(-50%, calc(-50% + 6px)) to translate(-50%, -50%).

motion.name: drawer-enter
motion.purpose: Drawer opacity .5 to 1 and translateX(-16px) to translateX(0).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce overrides animation/transition durations, sets one animation iteration and scroll-behavior: auto.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Charcoal primary action; real pending state disables repeat submission.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display:inline-flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; gap:8px; min-height:42px; padding:10px 17px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:var(--radius, 6px); background:var(--ink, #202523); color:var(--surface, #ffffff); font:600 13px/1.45 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; text-align:center; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background:#353d38; } .ds-button-primary:active { background:#111713; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #0d7c66); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; } @media(max-width:600px) { .ds-button-primary { min-height:44px; } }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined secondary action with a stronger control stroke than section rules.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display:inline-flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; gap:8px; min-height:42px; padding:10px 17px; border:1px solid var(--control-line, #828e85); border-radius:var(--radius, 6px); background:var(--surface, #ffffff); color:var(--ink, #202523); font:600 13px/1.45 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; text-align:center; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background:var(--surface-subtle, #f5f6f3); border-color:#6f7f73; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #0d7c66); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-button-secondary:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; } @media(max-width:600px) { .ds-button-secondary { min-height:44px; } }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Explicitly labelled destructive action, used with the existing confirmation flow.
components.css: .ds-button-danger { display:inline-flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; gap:8px; min-height:42px; padding:10px 17px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:var(--radius, 6px); background:var(--danger, #a62d29); color:var(--surface, #ffffff); font:600 13px/1.45 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; text-align:center; } .ds-button-danger:hover { background:#89231f; } .ds-button-danger:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #0d7c66); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-button-danger:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; } @media(max-width:600px) { .ds-button-danger { min-height:44px; } }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet contextual action; not a substitute for a visible primary action.
components.css: .ds-button-ghost { display:inline-flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; gap:8px; min-height:42px; padding:10px 17px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:var(--radius, 6px); background:transparent; color:var(--ink, #202523); font:600 13px/1.45 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; text-align:center; } .ds-button-ghost:hover { background:var(--surface-subtle, #f5f6f3); } .ds-button-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #0d7c66); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-button-ghost:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; } @media(max-width:600px) { .ds-button-ghost { min-height:44px; } }

components.name: Labelled Native Field
components.description: Visible label and native control; no floating-label or custom keyboard model.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; align-content:start; gap:8px; min-width:0; margin:0 0 20px; color:var(--ink, #202523); font:600 13px/1.5 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; } .ds-field-input { min-width:0; min-height:42px; padding:9px 12px; border:1px solid var(--control-line, #828e85); border-radius:var(--radius, 6px); background:var(--surface, #ffffff); color:var(--ink, #202523); caret-color:var(--accent, #0d7c66); font:400 14px/1.5 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color:#6d756f; opacity:1; } .ds-field-input:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color:#66766b; } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #0d7c66); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-field-input:disabled { background:var(--surface-subtle, #f5f6f3); color:var(--muted, #636d66); cursor:not-allowed; } .ds-field-input[readonly] { background:var(--surface-subtle, #f5f6f3); } .ds-field-input[aria-invalid=true] { border-color:var(--danger, #a62d29); } @media(max-width:600px) { .ds-field-input { min-height:44px; font-size:16px; } }

components.name: Selected Navigation
components.description: Green-wash current-page state, reusing the desktop rail treatment inside the mobile drawer.
components.html: Subscriptions
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:11px; min-height:42px; margin:2px 0; padding:9px 12px; border-radius:var(--radius, 6px); color:#505b53; font:500 13px/1.4 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background:var(--surface-subtle, #f5f6f3); color:var(--ink, #202523); text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav-link[aria-current=page] { background:var(--accent-soft, #e9f3ed); color:var(--accent-ink, #08624f); font-weight:600; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #0d7c66); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-nav-link svg { flex-shrink:0; }

components.name: Text Status Badge
components.description: Non-interactive saved-state label; never relies on color alone or adds button behavior.
components.css: .ds-status-active { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; width:fit-content; padding:3px 9px; border:1px solid #cde0d3; border-radius:5px; background:#edf6ef; color:#2c6946; font:500 11px/1.6 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; white-space:nowrap; }

components.name: Flat Editor Panel
components.description: Restrained white editor surface; not a requirement to box every group of records.
components.css: .ds-panel { min-width:0; padding:28px; border:1px solid var(--line, #dfe3de); border-radius:10px; background:var(--surface, #ffffff); color:var(--ink, #202523); font:400 15px/1.6 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; } .ds-panel h2 { margin:0 0 24px; color:var(--ink, #202523); font-size:19px; line-height:1.4; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.02em; } .ds-panel p { margin:0; color:var(--muted, #636d66); } @media(max-width:600px) { .ds-panel { padding:20px; } .ds-panel h2 { font-size:18px; margin-bottom:20px; } }

components.name: Error Notice
components.description: In-place alert with retained input; this specimen describes an error, not a fabricated backend result.
components.html: The action did not complete. Check the record before retrying.
components.css: .ds-notice-error { margin:16px 0; padding:12px 16px; border:1px solid #edc9c5; border-radius:var(--radius, 6px); background:var(--danger-soft, #fcf0ee); color:var(--danger, #a62d29); font:400 13px/1.65 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; overflow-wrap:anywhere; }

narrative.overview:
Brightloop is a minimal, professional workspace: near-white paper, a white navigation rail, charcoal headings and primary actions, and restrained green wayfinding. Thin rules and generous section spacing organise dense operational records without turning every group into a card. The loop mark and lowercase wordmark supply identity; no decorative imagery is needed.

This is the finished implementation contract, extracted on 2026-10-31 from `src/app/globals.css`, `src/components/` and the admin feature components. It replaces the provisional direction values with built values. The approved code-led preview (seed `b221723e`, `model-pick`) establishes the world, not production rows or unbuilt controls. The finish reviewer returned **ship (9/10)** across the supplied desktop list/detail and mobile list/create/drawer/dialog captures. That bounded review is not a whole-product accessibility, performance or production-readiness claim.
keyCharacteristics: Paper backgrounds, white surfaces, fine neutral rules.
Charcoal actions; green selection, links and keyboard focus.
Compact labelled records beneath generous page headings.
Native fields, explicit feedback and text-labelled status.
A persistent desktop rail that becomes a mobile drawer.

rules.name: The Meaning Before Color Rule
rules.body: Always render the state or outcome in words; color never stands in for saved lifecycle, pause, closure or delivery state.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: Resting records and editor panels use rules and white/paper contrast, not shadows. Nested panels flatten into ruled sections instead of accumulating bordered cards.

dos: **Do** reuse the loop mark, lowercase wordmark and restrained green wayfinding.
**Do** preserve labelled native fields, visible keyboard focus and text-labelled status.
**Do** keep wide records in labelled horizontal scroll regions and stack forms at the existing breakpoints.
**Do** show real server-returned totals, saved state, pending work and recoverable errors without discarding input.
**Do** retain shared component props and CSS hooks for existing portal, finance and auth consumers.
donts: **Don't** add gradients, glass, ornamental imagery or decorative metric cards to this paper-and-ink workspace.
**Don't** nest bordered panels when a ruled section expresses the same hierarchy.
**Don't** hide financial columns, calculate authoritative totals in the browser or present preview/demo rows as production data.
**Don't** use color alone for state or claim success before the server confirms it.
**Don't** turn shared presentation work into backend, authorization or teammate-owned page-logic changes.
